assets.summary: Eliminate repetitive auth and error boilerplate in Next.js App Router API routes using a withAuth wrapper
strategy: Create a withAuth wrapper that handles user authentication and error catching
Replace duplicated requireAuth checks plus null guard and try/catch in each route

assets.summary: withAuth wrapper for Next.js App Router that cuts API route boilerplate by half
assets.content: withAuth is a higher-order function wrapping Next.js route handlers. It handles auth via requireAuth and catches exceptions. Usage: export const GET = withAuth(async ({ user }) => { ... })
